definition.summary: SS Clinic is the clinic brand of SuamiSihat®, run by SuamiSihat Clinic Sdn. Bhd. It offers consultations, health checks, telehealth and personal care plans for Malaysian husbands, always starting with a proper check before any treatment.

pillars.title: Check first
pillars.text: Every assessment comes before any treatment recommendation.

pillars.title: Dignity
pillars.text: No shame. Brotherly and respectful of the husband and his family.

pillars.title: Honesty
pillars.text: No guarantees, no countdowns, no miracle claims.

False urgency such as countdowns or 'last slots'

guideline.clearSpace: To be confirmed. Until then, keep a gap at least the height of the capital letters in the wordmark on every side.
guideline.minimumSize: To be confirmed with the logo kit owner.
do: Use the supplied logo files; never retype the wordmark
Photograph real clinic staff and patients, with written consent
Put text on solid panels, not on busy photos
dont: Do not use images of distressed men or pill bottles
Do not show or name individual doctors in brand material
Do not make cure, speed or comparison claims

typography.body: Inter on the web; 15 px body text, 1.7 line height

guideline.grid: Cards 12 px corner radius; buttons 8 px or fully rounded; 64 px safe margin on square ads; keep reel text inside the 1080 x 1350 px safe area.
guideline.photography: Dignified Malaysian men aged 32 to 55, warm clinic lighting, natural eye contact, health-check equipment in use. Real clinic photography with written consent only; the photo library is to be confirmed.
